_comment: Aspect texts: one template per aspect type; {A}/{b} are filled with the two points' themes (capitalized / lower-case). Only shown when review is 'approved'.

conjunction.template: {A} and {b} work as one in you, so they tend to show up together. This blend can be a real source of strength once you notice it.
challenges: Hard to tell the two apart

sextile.template: {A} and {b} support each other in a friendly way, offering openings you can choose to use. A little effort here can bring easy, steady progress.

square.template: {A} and {b} may pull against each other, creating a tension you can feel. Working with both, instead of choosing one, can turn this friction into real drive.

trine.template: {A} and {b} flow together easily, giving you a natural gift in this part of life. Using it on purpose can help it shine even more.

opposition.template: {A} and {b} sit on opposite sides, so you may swing between them or meet one through other people. Finding a balance between the two can help you feel whole.
challenges: Sees your own traits in others
